background: Macquarie Bank is the banking entity of Macquarie Group, Australia's largest investment bank, funded by Australian deposits and wholesale markets and lending on residential mortgages, to businesses and in asset finance, alongside its commodities and markets business.
synthesis: The bank is rated AA- on average across two of the three main agencies, the weaker of them at A+, both on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 26 May 2024. The site holds no capital or liquidity figures for the bank, so there is no peer comparison to make against the Australian majors. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A highly rated name whose earnings are more market-driven than those of the big four, which the lower of its two ratings reflects.
